name: Tai video Youtube (batch link -> MP4/MP3 + thumbnail)
description: Dan nhieu link Youtube (moi dong 1 link). Chon chat luong (Best/2160p/1440p/1080p/720p/480p/360p) va dinh dang (MP4 hoac MP3). Ten file output = tieu de video. Tai kem thumbnail .jpg cung ten. Khong re-encode: MP4 chi doi container (remux). Loai bo AV1 o moi muc chat luong vi ffmpeg bundled (2018) khong mux duoc AV1 vao MP4; voi 1440p/2160p file MP4 co the chua VP9 thay vi H.264 - mot so player cu co the khong mo duoc. File da co san trong Output se duoc bo qua. Dung player_client de tranh loi 'Sign in to confirm you're not a bot': mac dinh android_vr (khong can PO Token, khong can JS runtime); neu Youtube khoa ca android_vr, doi gia tri thanh web_embedded ngay trong file JSON nay, khong can build lai app. De trong ('') se tat han co --extractor-args.
